objectives: Apply the ethical duties of the notary office in daily client contact.
Recognise a client who is vulnerable or under pressure, and protect the client's free will.
Recognise the warning signs of identity fraud, forged documents and property fraud.
Refuse a request correctly, and document the refusal.
Handle complaints and difficult situations professionally.

cards.front: Where are the ethical duties of the notary set out?
cards.back: In the law (Art. 34(1) ЗННД), the oath (Art. 15(1)) and the **Ethics Code of the Notaries**, an integral part of the statute of the Notary Chamber, to which Art. 34(1) refers.

cards.front: What does the notary swear in the oath?
cards.back: To keep the Constitution and the laws exactly, to perform the professional duties **honestly, in good faith and impartially**, and to be worthy of the trust and respect of the profession (Art. 15(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: What does impartiality mean at the desk?
cards.back: The office serves **both parties** and does not take sides (Art. 24 ЗННД).

cards.front: Who explains the legal consequences to the parties?
cards.back: The **notary** (Art. 25(1) ЗННД); the staff pass legal questions to the notary or the assistant notary.

cards.front: A client asks the clerk: "Is a gift or a sale better for me?" What does the clerk answer?
cards.back: That the **notary** will explain the consequences of each deal (Art. 25(1) ЗННД); the clerk gives no legal advice and takes the question to the notary.

cards.front: An elderly client comes with a nephew who answers every question. What does the notary do?
cards.back: Meets the client **alone** (Art. 20 ЗННД), unless the client wants others present; checks the free will before the act.

cards.front: Can the other party act as interpreter?
cards.back: **No**; the notary appoints the interpreter (Art. 582 ГПК), and a person who gains from the act cannot interpret (Art. 584 item 4 ГПК).

cards.front: Name three signs of an impostor owner.
cards.back: The face does not match; the register shows a different document or photo; little knowledge of the property; a hurried cheap sale (practice).

cards.front: An agent presents a power of attorney. How do you check that it is not revoked?
cards.back: In the **information system** of the Notary Chamber, where revocations are entered (Art. 9а item 2 Наредба № 32).

cards.front: Doubts about the identity remain after the checks. What may the notary do?
cards.back: **Refuse** the act (Art. 574 ГПК); the refusal is appealed within one week before the regional court (Art. 577(1), 275(1) ГПК).

cards.front: To whom is a suspicion of money laundering reported?
cards.back: The **Financial Intelligence Directorate of SANS**, without tipping off (Art. 72, 80 ЗМИП).

cards.front: Where can a client complain about a notary?
cards.back: To the **Council of Notaries** or the **Minister of Justice** (Art. 77(1) and 80б(2) ЗННД).

quiz.question: A client asks the clerk: "Is it better for me to donate or to sell the flat to my son?" What should the clerk do?
options: Pass the question to the notary or the assistant notary
Give a personal opinion, based on the office's experience
Say that the two deals have the same legal effect
Recommend a lawyer of the office, for a commission
quiz.explanation: Art. 25(1) ЗННД: the notary protects the rights of the parties, clarifies their will and explains the legal consequences to them clearly. The clerk does not advise; a commission for a recommendation conflicts with impartiality (Art. 24).

quiz.question: An elderly seller's nephew insists on staying in the room and answers all questions. What is the right approach?
options: The notary talks with the seller alone
The nephew answers; he knows the facts of the file
The deal is cancelled at once, without an explanation
The nephew signs the deed instead of the seller
quiz.explanation: Art. 20 ЗННД: the notary meets alone with the person who asked for the act, unless that person wants others present. The seller, not the nephew, decides; a signature by the nephew needs a power of attorney.

quiz.question: The buyer offers to translate for a seller who does not speak Bulgarian. Is it allowed?
options: No; the notary appoints an interpreter who meets the conditions
Yes; the buyer's translation saves time and money for both parties
Yes, if the buyer is fluent in the language of the seller
Yes, if the seller agrees to the buyer as interpreter
quiz.explanation: Art. 582 ГПК: when a participant does not know Bulgarian, the notary appoints an interpreter; Art. 584 item 4: a person in whose favour the act contains a disposition cannot be an interpreter. The seller's consent does not remove the bar.

quiz.question: The identity card of a "seller" was issued last week, and the photo in the national register differs. What do you do?
options: Stop and inform the notary; this is a sign of an impostor
Proceed; a new card is valid like any other card
Ask the buyer whether he trusts the seller personally
Take a photograph of the seller and proceed with the deed
quiz.explanation: Art. 25(3) ЗННД: for every certification about rights in real estate the notary checks the database of identity documents (Art. 19(2)). A different photo is a warning sign of an impostor; the notary refuses the act when the doubt remains (Art. 574 ГПК).

quiz.question: An agent presents a power of attorney to sell a house; the information system shows its revocation last month. What happens?
options: The notary refuses to rely on the power
The act proceeds, because the agent holds the original
The act proceeds, if the buyer is in good faith
The clerk calls the lawyer of the agent for an explanation
quiz.explanation: Art. 41(1) ЗЗД: the power ends with its revocation; the revocation is entered in the information system (Art. 9а item 2 Наредба № 32) so that notaries see it. The original in the agent's hands and the buyer's good faith give no authority.

quiz.question: A client wants a deed back-dated to last year "for tax reasons". What is the answer?
options: No; the date must be true, and a false act is a crime
Yes, if both parties agree to the date in writing
Yes, against the additional fee of the tariff for the act
Only for a gift, where no tax is due
quiz.explanation: Art. 580 item 1 ГПК: the deed states the true date and place; Art. 574: the notary performs no act contrary to the law. A false official document is a crime under Art. 311 of the Criminal Code (outside the library).

quiz.question: The notary refused an act; the client wants to appeal. What does the office provide?
options: A written refusal with reasons and the date of the refusal
Nothing; a refusal is oral and is not appealed
A refund of all fees paid by the client so far to the office
A recommendation of another notary of the district
quiz.explanation: Art. 577(1) ГПК: a refusal to perform a notarial certification is appealed with a private appeal before the regional court; Art. 275(1): within one week of the notice. The written refusal with reasons and date lets the client appeal in time.

quiz.question: Three witnesses in a circumstantial verification are not neighbours and repeat identical words. What is the concern?
options: Possible false testimony; the notary may refuse to recognise
Nothing; three witnesses satisfy the law in every verification
The procedure is void, because they are not neighbours
The mayor answers for the witnesses, not the notary
quiz.explanation: Art. 587(2) ГПК: the witnesses are, as far as possible, neighbours; the notary questions them and decides. Identical statements are a warning sign of false testimony; Art. 587(3): the notary decides with a reasoned decision and may refuse to recognise the ownership.

quiz.question: A client complains in writing about the notary's conduct. What does the clerk do?
options: Passes it to the notary at once
Files it, without telling the notary
Answers it personally, in the name of the office
Sends it to the Notary Chamber directly
quiz.explanation: A complaint may lead to a disciplinary proceeding (Art. 77(1) ЗННД) or an inspection ordered by the Minister of Justice (Art. 80б(2)). The notary must know at once and answers personally; the clerk neither hides nor answers the complaint.

quiz.question: Why is a refusal better than a doubtful act?
options: An act for an impostor harms the owner; the notary is liable
A refusal cannot be appealed, so it ends the matter for good
The fee for the refused act stays with the notary
The liability passes to the other notary who later acts
quiz.explanation: Art. 73(1) ЗННД: the notary is liable for the damage caused by a culpable breach of his duties, up to the certified material interest. A refusal may be appealed (Art. 577 ГПК), so it does not end the matter, but it causes no damage to the real owner.

quiz.question: A close friend of the notary is the buyer in a sale. May the notary issue the deed?
options: Only if the friendship raises no justified doubt of impartiality
Yes; only the relatives listed in Art. 575 ГПК disqualify the notary
No; any personal acquaintance with a party disqualifies the notary
Yes, if the seller agrees in writing to the notary
quiz.explanation: Art. 23 ЗННД: the notary examines every request, unless he has an interest in the act or special relations with a party that raise a justified doubt of his impartiality. Art. 575 ГПК lists the relatives who always disqualify; a friendship is judged under Art. 23.

quiz.question: An estate agent who brings many clients offers the clerk a bonus for each file. What does the clerk do?
options: Declines; the office accepts no gifts from clients or agents
Accepts; the bonus does not change the fee of the notary for the file
Accepts, if the notary is informed of the bonus
Accepts, if the agent is registered as a company
quiz.explanation: Art. 24 ЗННД: the notary takes no side; a bonus from an agent ties the office to one party. Art. 34(1): the notary keeps the professional ethics and the prestige of the profession under the statute of the Chamber, and trains the staff in it (Art. 34(2)).
